```python
"""Archive a note: node.archive behavior.

Reads through the kernel's Store; never touches rows directly.
"""

from kernel import AppError, require_session


def archive_note(store, session, note_id=None):
    """Archive a live note. Returns id, title, archived per the contract."""
    require_session(session)

    if not note_id:
        raise AppError("INVALID_PARAMETER")

    note = store.note(note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND")

    if note["archived"]:
        raise AppError("ALREADY_ARCHIVED")

    note["archived"] = True
    saved = store.save_note(note)

    return {
        "id": saved["id"],
        "title": saved["title"],
        "archived": saved["archived"],
    }
```

```python
        raise AppError("INVALID_PARAMETER")

    note = store.note(note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND")
    if note["archived"]:
        raise AppError("ALREADY_ARCHIVED")
```
```python
    return note

    """Archive one note and return the contract's output."""
    require_session(session)
    note_id = _validated_note_id(note_id)

    note = _live_note(store, note_id)
    note["archived"] = True
    saved = store.save_note(note)

    return {
        "id": saved["id"],
        "title": saved["title"],
        "archived": saved["archived"],
    }
```
